purpose: Bind the BATCH-015 rank-1 producer package (O(1)-memory fresh-key Feistel substitute oracle and the decisive-exposure cipher-substitution comparison) by hash before independent review.

outcomes_as_reported.producer_headline: THE EXCESS STAYS ABSENT. Both arms read OUTCOME-A'' under the preregistered decision rule: M1 (fresh-key-per-trial 16-round SipRound-Feistel substitute at matched exposure 2^30) read 1 hit against the matched live 5-round AES arm's 14 (p=9.765625e-4 exact, R=1.0, Garwood 95% CI [0.025, 5.572] containing 1, rate ratio 14.0 CI [2.13, 592.0]); M2 (same oracle, 8x exposure 2^33) read 10 hits against its own ~8-event analytic null (R=1.25, 95% CI [0.599, 2.299] containing 1; exposure-weighted test vs the live arm p=5.753e-8), far below the ~112 hits an AES-level rate extrapolated to 8x would predict. The cipher-substitution absence (BATCH-009 OUTCOME-A, BATCH-014 OUTCOME-A') therefore replicates at decisive exposure on an independent, O(1)-memory, ideal-APPROXIMATING (not merely non-ideal) substitute with per-trial fresh-permutation semantics. Additionally, the matched live arm reproduced BATCH-009's P1-R5-PAIR reading EXACTLY -- 14 hits, identical hit-trial indices, identical plaintext-stream digests -- verified field-by-field against the immutable source file.
outcomes_as_reported.exposure: Live AES arm 2^30 reproduced BATCH-009's frozen P1-R5-PAIR reading exactly (14 hits, plaintext-stream digests byte-identical); substitute M1 2^30 = 1 hit; substitute M2 2^33 = 10 hits. No shortfall: decisive exposure reached for both arms plus 8x on the substitute.
outcomes_as_reported.preregistered_decision_rule_outcome: OUTCOME-A'' on both preregistered comparisons (M1 matched 2^30: exact conditional p=9.765625e-4, Garwood CI [0.0253,5.572] contains 1; M2 2^33: exposure-weighted p=5.753e-8, CI [0.599,2.299] contains 1). Plain statement: THE EXCESS STAYS ABSENT under the fresh-key-per-trial ideal-approximating O(1)-memory substitute at decisive exposure.
outcomes_as_reported.budget: 2231 s of 7200 s wall clock; peak RSS 259.5 MB (selfcheck keycheck table) vs 4 GB; measurement arms 1.5-2.0 MB confirming O(1)-per-query empirically; 6 of 6 runs; budget NOT exhausted.
